## 1. PRE-LAUNCH PREPARATION

### Launch Checklist

**2 Weeks Before Launch:**
```
✓ Theme submitted and approved
✓ Item description finalized
✓ Screenshots optimized (1200×900)
✓ Live demo fully functional
✓ Documentation complete (HTML + PDF)
✓ Support email/system ready
✓ Social media accounts created
✓ Landing page prepared (optional)
✓ Email list ready (if available)
✓ Promotional materials created
```

**1 Week Before Launch:**
```
✓ Final testing complete
✓ Pricing strategy finalized
✓ Launch discount planned (optional)
✓ Promotional banners created
✓ Blog post written
✓ Social media posts scheduled
✓ Affiliate materials prepared (if applicable)
✓ FAQ section populated
```

**Launch Day:**
```
✓ Monitor item page for issues
✓ Respond to initial comments quickly
✓ Post on social media
✓ Send email announcement
✓ Monitor support tickets
✓ Track initial sales
```

## 2. PRICING STRATEGY

### Pricing Tiers (ThemeForest)

**Regular License Pricing:**
```
Entry Level: $19 - $29
- Simple themes
- Limited features
- Good for beginners
- Lower expectations

Mid-Range: $39 - $59 (RECOMMENDED)
- Full-featured themes
- Professional quality
- Most competitive
- Best value perception

Premium: $69 - $99
- Advanced features
- Exceptional design
- Page builder included
- Premium plugins bundled

Elite: $99+
- Multi-purpose themes
- Extensive customization
- Multiple demos
- Premium support
```

**Pricing Factors:**
```
Increase Price For:
✓ Multiple demo variations (5+)
✓ Page builder integration (Elementor Pro, WPBakery)
✓ Bundled premium plugins ($200+ value)
✓ Advanced features (mega menus, AJAX, animations)
✓ WooCommerce full integration
✓ Extensive documentation
✓ Video tutorials included
✓ Priority support offered

Decrease Price For:
✓ First theme (establish reputation)
✓ Simple/minimal design
✓ Limited features
✓ Niche market (smaller audience)
```

### Extended License

```
Regular License: End product is free
Extended License: End product is sold (30x regular price)

Example:
Regular: $59
Extended: $59 × 30 = $1,770

Most sales are Regular License (95%+)
Extended License is rare but valuable
```

## 4. SCREENSHOT STRATEGY

### Required Screenshots

**Main Screenshot (1200×900 - EXACT):**
```
✓ Homepage design
✓ Professional quality
✓ Clean, uncluttered
✓ Shows key features
✓ No browser chrome (just content)
✓ High contrast
✓ Readable text
```

**Additional Preview Images:**
```
Upload 8-12 preview images showing:
✓ Homepage (desktop)
✓ Homepage (mobile/tablet)
✓ Single blog post
✓ Blog archive
✓ Shop page (if WooCommerce)
✓ Single product page
✓ About page
✓ Contact page
✓ Customizer in action
✓ Page builder demonstration
✓ Different demo variations
✓ Feature highlights
```

### Screenshot Best Practices

```
DO:
✅ Use real content (no lorem ipsum)
✅ Show actual features
✅ Include device mockups for mobile views
✅ Add subtle annotations for features
✅ Use high-quality images
✅ Maintain consistent branding

DON'T:
❌ Use generic stock photos only
❌ Show empty/placeholder content
❌ Include browser toolbars
❌ Add excessive text overlays
❌ Use low-quality screenshots
❌ Mislead with Photoshop mockups
```

### Response Time Standards

```
Target Response Times:
✓ Critical bugs: 2-4 hours
✓ General questions: 24 hours
✓ Feature requests: 48 hours
✓ Comments: 1-2 hours

Set Expectations:
- Business hours: Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm EST
- Weekend: Limited support
- Holidays: Advance notice
```

### Support Templates

**Initial Response:**
```
Hi [Name],

Thank you for purchasing [Theme Name]!

I've received your question about [issue]. Let me help you with that.

[Answer or request for more info]

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Theme Name] Support Team
```

**Bug Fix Response:**
```
Hi [Name],

Thank you for reporting this issue. I've confirmed it's a bug and we're working on a fix.

We'll release an update within [timeframe] that resolves this.

I'll notify you when the update is available.

Thank you for your patience!

Best regards,
[Your Name]
```

**Feature Request Response:**
```
Hi [Name],

Thank you for your suggestion about [feature]!

This is a great idea. We'll add it to our roadmap for future updates.

While I can't guarantee a timeline, we do plan to implement this in version [X.X].

Best regards,
[Your Name]
```

## 7. REVIEW MANAGEMENT

### Getting Reviews

**Timing:**
```
✓ Wait 7-14 days after purchase
✓ Confirm customer is satisfied
✓ Ensure no open support tickets
✓ Check for repeat customers
```

**How to Ask:**
```
Subject: Enjoying [Theme Name]? We'd love your feedback!

Hi [Name],

I hope you're enjoying [Theme Name]! It's been [X days] since your purchase.

If you're happy with the theme, we'd greatly appreciate if you could leave a rating. It helps other users discover our work!

[Link to Rate Item]

If you're experiencing any issues, please let us know before rating - we're here to help!

Best regards,
[Your Name]
```

### Handling Negative Reviews

**1-3 Star Reviews:**
```
Step 1: Respond Publicly & Professionally
"Hi [Name], I'm sorry you're experiencing issues. I'd like to help resolve this. Could you please contact our support so we can assist you directly? [support link]"

Step 2: Contact Privately
Offer personal assistance to resolve issue

Step 3: Request Review Update
If issue resolved: "I'm glad we could help! If you're satisfied, would you consider updating your review?"

Remember:
✓ Never argue publicly
✓ Always professional
✓ Show willingness to help
✓ Demonstrate active support
```

## 9. SALES OPTIMIZATION

### Conversion Optimization

**Item Page Elements:**
```
✓ Compelling title
✓ Professional screenshots
✓ Clear feature list
✓ Live demo link prominent
✓ Video preview (recommended)
✓ Comparison table (vs competitors)
✓ Customer testimonials
✓ FAQ section
✓ Detailed changelog
✓ Response to ALL comments
```

### Pricing Psychology

```
Launch Discount (Optional):
- Initial price: $59
- Launch price: $39 (33% off)
- Duration: First 100 sales or 2 weeks
- Creates urgency

Regular Pricing:
- Establish value at normal price
- Occasional sales (Black Friday, New Year)
- Don't discount too often (devalues theme)

Price Increases:
- Increase price as features added
- Notify customers before increase
- "Price will increase from $59 to $69 on [date]"
```
